name: Frost Mauler
description: The Winterworks Cold Zone boss: a huge indigo-furred beast between a dire wolf and a giant bear, half dead and half frozen: a pale mane, ice crystal clusters erupting from its back and left shoulder, an ice-sheathed foreleg and tail club, half its skull bare bone round a glowing socket, a cage of bare ribs over a frost core on its right flank, two massive sabre fangs. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model (fur fringes are cards).
